title: How Small Animals Kill Far Bigger Ones, and Doug (Marathon)
intro: A honey badger, a wolverine, a hornet crew and an ant swarm. None is bigger than Doug's leg. Each has beaten something far larger. Doug is the next thing on the list.
description: Four full episodes back to back: why lions think twice about a honey badger, how a wolverine kills a reindeer six times its weight, how 30 giant hornets destroy a hive of 30,000 bees, and why army ants only kill what can't run. Real science, cartoon deaths.
